artifacts.summary: All 8 plan phases complete: Piece 1 heartbeat-silence diagnosis plus a system-wide dispatch-boundary heartbeat fix and advisory adoption lint; Piece 2 held-live third lock state plus a matching cmd_acquire overlap-pass escalation, both consuming session_liveness() keyed on session_id; Piece 3 registry file_scope re-derivation on heartbeat; both absorbed defects (Class E session-id threading, batch-size message fix). orchestrate-batch-admit.sh untouched throughout.

completion_data.completion_summary: Implemented all 8 phases of the honest-session-liveness plan: diagnosed and closed the heartbeat-coverage gap system-wide via dispatch-boundary pulses, added a held-live lock state and a matching cmd_acquire overlap escalation (both keyed on session_id via the shared session_liveness() verdict), re-derived the session registry's file_scope on every heartbeat, and fixed both absorbed defects (waking the dead Class E contention review, correcting the batch-size message). A Phase 8 full-repo gate sweep additionally found and fixed three real defects (a Gate 20 context-budget overage, three unregistered manifest.json scripts, and four lint-state-writer-boundary.sh false positives on test fixtures).

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new output state to a shell CLI whose consumers gate on EXIT CODES with a catch-all branch, prefer a new output-line PREFIX carrying an EXISTING exit code over a new exit code, and pick a prefix that is a substring of neither existing prefix (e.g. held-live, not held-stale-pid-alive) so a future substring consumer cannot mis-match.

When constructing a fixture to test a two-live-sessions liveness-escalation code path (a held lock resolved via session registry), decouple the registered session's OWN task_numbers/file_scope from the held task's overlap path. If both match, a separate pre-existing contention pass (keyed on the registry entry's own declared scope) can independently fire and confound the pristine-vs-modified differential, making the test appear to prove something it is not isolating.

After any source-store-only edit (growing a context/*.md file's line count, or adding a new script), run the repo's doc-lint/deploy-drift gate (check-extension-docs.sh / verify-deploy.sh Gate 3/5) BEFORE closing out a task -- it catches index-entries.json line_count drift and unregistered manifest.json provides.scripts entries that are easy to forget mid-implementation and otherwise surface only later as someone else's confusing gate failure.
